world.description: A courtyard house in the hills above Sintra: eight rooms around a stone patio and a lap pool.

more.text: Have a look at the view, then try the lights: the switches are by the doors.

start.text: Come in, make yourself at home. The light is best at this hour.

more.text: Everything in here opens: try the drawers and the cupboards.

start.text: Coffee's just made. Help yourself, the mugs are on the counter.

more.text: Take any book you like from the shelves.

start.text: I was just reading in here. It is the quietest room in the house.

controls: E — open · use · pick up · talk
intro.objective: Walk in, say hello to the family, open the drawers and the shutters of the day, carry a coffee out to the patio.
intro.tagline: A courtyard house in the hills above Sintra.
intro.title: Casa del Patio

world.name: Casa del Patio
